The '''2024 Retro League Event 3''' was the third event of the [[2024 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]] (30 June – 14 August 2024), played in [[Premiere - Endor]] format.<ref name="t84005" /> [[Paul Todd Feldman]] won.<ref name="p1428053" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' 30 June – 14 August 2024
* '''Players:''' 67 (66 in the posted standings)
* '''Winner:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]

== Final standings ==
Final standings as posted by the tournament director (posted as images), in posted order.
